senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to bend, go forward,] to advance, precede; to anticipate.
units: Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ bot. צפה … מוטב שיִקְדּוֹם … לכספו וכ׳ the Lord foresaw that Haman the wicked would weigh his silver for Israel’s destruction (Esth. III, 9), and he said, it is better that my children’s silver (the half-Shekel, Ex. XXX, 11 sq.) anticipate Haman’s silver (to act as a protection from evil designs); ib. I, 70ᵈ bot. שיַּקְדִּים (Hif.). Sifra Vayiḳra, Ḥob., Par. 3, ch. V, v. infra.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:4">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ששה דברים קָדְמוּ וכ׳</he> six things preceded the creation of the world.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>איני יודע איזה מהן קוֹדֵם אם התורה קָדְמָה וכ׳</he> I know not yet, which of them was first, whether the Torah was created before the throne of glory &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:8">Ib.</cite> <he>התורה קדמה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S02061"><he>קְרִימָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 100a">Ḥull. 100ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>ק׳ וסלקו</he> he removed it first (before putting in other pieces).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>, beg. <he>יתוש קְדָמְךָ</he>, v. <cite ref="J00724"><he>יַתּוּשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:11">B. Mets. II, 11</cite> <he>אבדתו … אבדתו קוֹדֶמֶת</he> if a man’s own loss and his father’s loss are to be attended to, his own has the precedence; <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:11">ib.</cite> <he>שלו קודמת</he> (Bab. ed. 33ᵃ <he>קודם</he>).

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:9">Ab. III, 9</cite> <he>כל … קודמת לחכמתו וכ׳</he> he to whom fear of sin comes before his learning, his learning will endure. Y. Ned. IX, 42ᶜ bot. <he>חיי העיר הזאת קוֹדְמִין וכ׳</he> the supply of provisions for the people of one’s own town has the precedence over &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:4">Kel. XXV, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01336"><he>כַּתְּ</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to get the start of. Y. Taan. I, end, 64ᵈ שלא יְקַדְּמֶנּוּ אחר lest another man get ahead of him (in proposing to a woman he desires to marry); Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ bot.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 34:3">Sifré Deut. 34</cite> <he>לא קִידְּמוּם מצוות וכ׳</he> no other commands were promulgated before them; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to advance; to do first; to anticipate, provide against. Y. Meg. l. c. לפיכך מַקְדִּימִין וקירין וכ׳ therefore we read the section of Sh’ḳalim first (before the first of Adar, and before the Sabbath Zakhor); Bab. ib. 13ᵇ לפיכך ה׳ שקליהן וכ׳ therefore the Lord ordered their Shekels in anticipation of his (Haman’s) Shekels, v. supra. Ib. 30ᵃ מקדימין לשבת שעברה we read it the Sabbath before, opp. מאחרין. Ib. when Purim falls on a Friday, מקדימין פרשת זכור we read the section Zakhor on the Sabbath previous. Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᵈ bot. ה׳ לו שכרי if he paid the builder in advance.
units: Zeb. 106ᵃ (ref. to Lev. IV, 12) שיהא שם דשן שיַקְדִּים לשם דשן this means that ashes must be there, that he must first have put ashes there; Sifra Vayikra l. c. שׁיִקְדּו̇ם; a. fr.—ה׳ שלום to salute first.
<cite ref="Berakhot 6b:37">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שיודע … יקדים לו שלום</he> he who knows his neighbor to be in the habit of greeting him, should salute him first.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:10">Ib. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הִקְדִּימוֹ אדם וכ׳</he> never was a man the first in saluting him, not even a stranger &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23">Ex. R. s. 23</cite> <he>באו … להַקְדִּים שירה</he> the angels came wanting to be the first to offer song; <he>יַקְדִּימוּ בני תחלה</he> let my children be the first; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּקְדָּם</he>; f. <he>מוּקְדֶּמֶת</he>; pl. <he>מוּקְדָּמִים</he> &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 6b">Pes. 6ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין מ׳ ומאוחר וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01044"><he>אָחַר</he></cite>.

Ib. שטרי חוב המ׳ antedated notes of indebtedness. M. Mets. V, 10 נתן עיניו … זו היא רבית מ׳ if he intends to borrow money, and he sends his neighbor a gift and says, ‘in order to make thee inclined to lend me money’,—this is interest paid in advance; a. fr.—2) to be early, zealous.
<cite ref="Nazir 23b">Naz. 23ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לעולם יקדים אדם לדבר וכ׳</he> man should always be anxious to do a good deed as early as possible.

<cite ref="Pesachim 4a">Pes. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מקדימין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00703"><he>זָרִיז</he></cite>; a. fr.—[Y. Erub. V, 22ᵈ top <he>שמקדימין העליון</he>, read: <he>שמקדירין</he> or <he>שמקדרין</he>, v. <cite ref="S00168"><he>קָדַר</he> I</cite>.]
